brief: Leadership offsite in Brandenburg for 18 people, 2 nights from 2027-06-02. One participant uses a wheelchair. Dietary: 3 vegan, 2 gluten-free. Budget EUR 12,000.

input.summary: Two step-free Brandenburg lodges, both 75 minutes by car from Berlin, are available from 2027-06-02 and fit the EUR 12,000 budget. Waldhaus am See is cheaper and a preferred vendor. Seeblick Lodge is a quieter, smaller alternative. Quotes assume 1 breakout room, but both lodges billed 3.

offers.tradeOff: Cheapest, preferred vendor, 4 breakout rooms and vegan/gluten-free as standard; it is a larger lodge, so less intimate than Seeblick.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Quiet lakeside lodge with a glass plenary room, but about EUR 546 more and only 20 bedrooms, so little spare capacity.

rfp.subject: Request for proposal: leadership offsite, 2 nights from 2027-06-02
rfp.body:
Hello,

We are planning a leadership offsite and would like a proposal.

Dates: arrival 2027-06-02, 2 nights (alternatives: 2027-06-09 or 2027-06-16).
Guests: 18, single-occupancy rooms (36 room nights).
Meeting space: one plenary meeting room plus breakout rooms (1 required; please quote what you can offer).
Dietary: 3 vegan, 2 gluten-free.
Accessibility: 1 wheelchair user. We need step-free access, an accessible bedroom and accessible meeting rooms.
Budget: up to EUR 12,000 in total.

Please include the day delegate package, rooms, breakout rooms and any extras.
Please reply by 2026-10-30.

Thank you,
Demo Co.
